sources.passage:
Databricks | OA 2023
You are given a matrix A with N rows and M columns.
You can start from any row on the 1st column, and your objective is to reach any row on the last column with minimum cost.
From cell (ith row, jth col), you can jump to any row in the (j+1)th col.

Let P1, P2, ...PM be the m elements which are traversed while going from 1st col to Mth col. Then the cost of this path is the absolute difference between max(P1, P2, .... PM) and min(P1, P2, ...PM).

Find the minimum cost possible to go from 1st column to Mth column.

Constraints:
1<= M,N <= 500
1 <= element of A <= 10^9

Example:
Input:
M = 3, N  = 3
matrix A :
1 4 5
2 9 3
3 1 1

Output:
0
Explanation:
we can pick 1 in 1st col, 1 in 2nd col and 1 in 3rd col. Cost  = 1 - 1 = 0

Can you please help solve this problem?

title: Maximize Score of Numbers in Ranges

reported.text: Given range starts and a common length d, pick one integer from each range [start, start+d] so that the minimum pairwise difference is maximized.

sources.passage:
D E Shaw Coding round
This question was in a recent coding round conducted by D. E. Shaw
A set of integer ranges (both ends inclusive) of d length each is given. The starting point of these ranges is given in an array starts. So the ith range (starting with 0 index consists of integers from starts[i] to starts[i] + d. One integer each is to be chosen from all the ranges, subject to the condition that the difference between any pair of chosen integers is at least dist. 

Given the starting points of the ranges, in an array starts, the length d of each range, the task is to determine the maximum possible value of dist such that it is possible to choose an integer from each of the ranges satisfying the above condition

Example 
Suppose n=3, d=2 and starts = [3,2,3]. 
So, the given ranges are  [[3,5],[2,4],[3,5]]
One integer each has to chosen from the given ranges such that the difference between any pair of chosen integers  is at least dist. The aim is to maximize such an integer dist
It is optimal to choose dist =1 
The integer 3 can be chosen from the 1st range -[3,5[
The integer 2 can be chosen from the 2nd range -[2,4]
The integer 4 can be chosen from the 3rd range -[3,5]
The difference between any chosen pair of integers is 1. 
So 1 is the maximum possible value of dist

The custom function will have 2 parameters, 
starts[n] : arr containing all the starting points
d : the length of each range
and will return the maximum possible dist
2<= n <=10^5
1 <=starts[i] <=10^14
1 <= d <=10^14

Q.1 To print from n to 1 (reverse order)
```python
def solve(n: int) -> void:
	for i in range(n,0,-1):
		print(i, end=" ")
```
Q.2 Given time in 12 hr clock format, find the smallest angle between the hour hand and minute hand
```python
def solve(h: int, m:int) -> int:
	hour_angle = 0.5 * (h * 60 + m)
    minute_angle = 6 * m
    angle = abs(hour_angle - minute_angle)
    angle = min(360 - angle, angle)
	return\xA0angle
```
